integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof with finite independent covariance and special-function checks; earlier general Kac–Rice framework is cited, not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Two-point factorial zero intensities at origin and infinitesimal separation, fixed finite positive beta; no whole-plane pair law, nearest-neighbor law, joint hole conditioning, or independent priority determination.
title: A unique fixed-scale repulsion peak for zeros of power-exponential Gaussian analytic functions
